label: Exposed — thin air
injuries: Winged-out from holding the pass; each interception lands heavier than the last

recentEvents.value: Its shadow wobbled before a dive and it nearly missed its own line; the traveler looked up and thanked his god for the weakness.

unresolvedConflicts.value: There is nothing here that belongs to him. Only road.

temporaryObjective.value: Say the plainest thing in its sky: only road here. Go home.
